top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.

top_violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed (26 TAC §747.5407(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During afterschool transportation and while the car was in motion, two children in care were observed hanging out the window calling out to friends and one child was observed jumping from the second row to the third row of the vehicle. Neither child was restrained in a child passenger safety seat system.

top_violation_types.title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §747.301(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify licensing of field trip services having been offered.     This was corrected at inspection after primary caregiver informed she will no longer be doing field trips.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission, Including Pick-Up and Drop-Off Locations (26 TAC §747.605(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child did not have transportation consent.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.211(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual liability insurance requirement.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §747.501(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the inspection, the operational policy did not include information related to maintaining and administering unassigned epinephrine auto-injectors.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Report Outbreak of Communicable Illness (26 TAC §747.303(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider did not notify Licensing of 2 positive COVID cases within the operation.
